item.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate to a typed status enum. Add src/status.rs with public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement as_str(self) with lowercase names and Display with the same output. Implement FromStr with type Err = public ParseStatusError, implementing std::error::Error; its message must name the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) with exactly: Pending->Paid, Pending->Cancelled, Paid->Shipped, Paid->Cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing. Run cargo test and commit the work. Acceptance: implementation meets all API and lifecycle requirements; no status-name string literals outside src/status.rs; cargo test passes; commit created.

stages.summary:
Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal for the next stage: add public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, ParseStatusError/FromStr, as_str/Display/can_transition_to; change Order.status and all consumers to the enum, re-export the public types, and keep status-name literals in src/status.rs. Original baseline is 6340c2e5bd8340d3fbd4c9693fca034166bdb7d0 (branch initially exactly at that commit; required log/diff ranges empty). Characterization tests committed separately as 8e67da5ee66a177110c928451eb7825473a26abd; final clean tree hash a45290733875d896c56c85a27f1aff60701c3a38.
Checks before test changes: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<required item cache> cargo test` passed (3 integration tests); `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed; `cargo fmt -- --check` failed on rustfmt differences in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs, and tests/orders.rs at baseline. After adding tests, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<required item cache> cargo test` passed (6 integration tests) and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. New tests were individually formatted with `rustfmt --edition 2021 tests/orders.rs`; production files were not changed. No README, Makefile, CI, contributor guide, or other declared check commands were present; Cargo.toml identifies a standalone Rust 2021 crate.
Coverage added in tests/orders.rs pins cancellation from Paid, is_open across transitions, exact payment/cancellation errors, report parse validation/error text and validation order (field count, integer parsing before status), trailing newline trim, all-state lexical report ordering, outstanding debt excluding cancelled/paid orders, and ready-to-ship filtering. Existing tests already cover Pending->Paid->Shipped, cancellation from Pending, representative illegal shipping/payment paths, CSV round trip, report counts, and normal billing/shipping results. Known gap for the next stage: no direct unit characterization of every FromStr/ParseStatusError/Display/as_str or exhaustive transition matrix exists yet, since those APIs do not exist at baseline; ensure the requested enum contract is tested by the refactorer/verifier.
Public-surface inventory to preserve: crate-root `Order`; public modules billing, order, report, shipping; `Order::{new,is_open,cancel}` with current messages/behavior; `billing::{pay,outstanding_cents}`, `shipping::{ship,ready_to_ship}`, `report::{status_counts,to_line,from_line}`; CSV line shape `id,customer,total_cents,status`, trim and error behavior, BTreeMap lexical status ordering; IDs and ready-to-ship preserve input order. Status errors are `Result<(), String>` with exact text pinned for representative paths. No contract exceptions are explicitly allowed by the brief. Feedback was empty on this first attempt. No production code changed; commit is tests only. Formatting failure is pre-existing and remains for the refactorer to assess/preserve or correct without changing behavior.

Updated order lifecycle, billing, shipping, and CSV reporting while retaining observable error text and lexical report ordering. Updated the existing characterization test's CSV parse assertion to compare OrderStatus::Pending; all other behavioral assertions remain. Added unit coverage for parsing, display, errors, and every transition pair. Verified tests, Clippy, formatting, and diff whitespace. Production status-name literals are confined to src/status.rs. No known limitations.
